news.title: Rising Energy Prices Shifting Near-Term Inflation Risk Upward: JPMorgan
news.summary: The rise in energy prices in the past few days is shifting the near-term inflation risk upward, according to JPMorgan chief economist Bruce Kasman.  "While our baseline forecast incorporates headline inflation settling at a 3%ar in the coming months, the pace of gain would be lifted towards a 4%ar if our commodity team’s adverse scenario of a sustained disruption to the Strait of Hormuz and Red Sea materializes," he said.  The comments, in a note this weekend, come as the market braces for a decision on interest rates by the Federal Reserve this week.
